inputs.text: Job Sikhala is urging people to reject proposed constitutional amendments reportedly intended to extend President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030, yet this account offers no clear case for his opposition. Constitutional questions must be settled through lawful institutions and an orderly process—not political pressure campaigns that risk unsettling the country. Whatever the merits of the proposal, respect for the rules and national stability should come before slogans.
